answer: We formalize a mechanism wherein staking collateral is locked via a zero-knowledge verifiable delay function to ensure Sybil resistance. In this setting, the comet consensus engine implements a raven filter to detect when malicious states wander from expected paths. By combining dynamic opportunity-cost bonds with subgame-perfect slashing penalties, the expected utility of identity multiplication is rendered strictly negative. Consequently, honest replication remains the unique, robust Nash equilibrium, forcing adversaries to abandon Sybil strategies.
